title: Career - Human-in-the-Loop AI Solutions Engineer
content:
Agar tum AI career soch rahe ho in 2026,
ek role clearly rising hai:
HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP AI Solutions Engineer.
Matlab tum models train nahi karte sirf.
Tum APPROVAL GATES design karte ho.
GPT-6 Cyber ke scope lessons aur
CodeRabbit jaise teams ke security-review
quotes se clear signal milta hai: capable
agents ke baad bhi humans review pe baithe
rehte hain.

Kyun ab.
Agents code likhte hain, leads score karte
hain, vulns propose karte hain.
Companies ko aise log chahiye jo scope
likhein, agent PRs verify karein, aur
irreversible actions se pehle human tap
lagayein.
Ishan Sharma style seedha bolo: job title
fancy ho sakta hai, skill concrete honi
chahiye.
Salary numbers main invent nahi karunga.
Demand signal process se aata hai, fake
CTC se nahi.

Skill 1: approval gates design karo.
Kaunsa action auto chal sakta hai, kaunsa
human ke bina nahi.
Send, merge, charge, deploy, production
probe - list banao.
Gate UX simple rakho: approve, edit,
reject, with reason codes.
Agar reason code nahi, tumhara eval set
kabhi nahi badhega.

Skill 2: AGENT PRS VERIFY KARO.
Diff padho jaise senior reviewer.
Kaunsi files, kaunse tests, koi secret to
leak nahi, koi invented API to nahi.
GPT-6 Cyber story mein bhi path-verify ka
lesson hai - result sahi, route galat ho
sakta hai.
Wahi habit coding agents pe lao: verify
the PATH, not only the green check.

Skill 3: scope define karo jaise
authorized defender.
In-bounds systems, out-of-bounds data,
time windows, kill switch.
OpenAI ne GPT-6 Cyber pe alignment
honeypot numbers dikhaye - 99.93% without
deployment prompt, 100% with.
Product lesson: bounds plus prompts plus
monitoring.
Solutions Engineer wahi translation
business workflows mein karta hai.

Portfolio jo interviews dilwaye.
Ek demo jahan agent draft kare, tum
approve karo - lead reply, code fix, ya
doc update.
Ek written scope template.
Ek REJECT LOG: 20 cases jahan tumne
confident-but-wrong agent output pakda.
Ek short write-up: failure modes aur rollback.
Yeh screenshots se zyada strong signal hai.

Is month ka practice block.
Roz 1 agent PR review.
Hafte mein 1 gate design: kisi bhi tool ke
liye send/merge rule.
Ek weekend: sandbox-only agent run with
explicit out-of-scope honeypot folder -
dekho agent touch karta hai ya nahi.
Jo bhi touch kare, monitoring gap note karo.
Salary claim mat crow. Process crow.

Mera take simple hai.
Human-in-the-Loop AI Solutions Engineer
next durable seat hai because models
faster ho rahe hain, liability nahi.
Jo log gates, scope, aur verification
design karenge, unhe teams hire hongi.
Jo sirf prompt paste karenge, unhe tools
replace karenge.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
